# codeonholiday

> Small, focused macOS apps for people who use their Mac every day.

codeonholiday makes native macOS menu bar apps: meeting reminders, screen annotation / presenting, and private local AI music. No bloated suites. Free cores with optional one-time Pro upgrades (no subscriptions).

## Products (summary)

- [Meetly](https://codeonholiday.com/meetly/): Fullscreen meeting reminders. **Free forever** (one calendar, fullscreen alerts, Quick Panel). Pro Lifetime **$9.99 one-time** — **Back to School: $6.99 (30% off) until 30 Sep 2026**.
- [LocalMelody](https://codeonholiday.com/localmelody/): Private local AI music on Apple Silicon. **Free** (15s songs). Pro Lifetime **$9.99 one-time** — **Back to School: $6.99 (30% off) until 30 Sep 2026**.
- [HoverBoard](https://codeonholiday.com/hoverboard/): Present / annotate / capture on Mac. **Free forever:** Spotlight, Break Timer, Screenshot, Screen Record. Pro Lifetime **$15.99 one-time** — **Back to School: $11.19 (30% off) until 30 Sep 2026**.

## Meetly — free (no Pro license)

Native menu bar app. Reads calendars already in macOS Calendar (Google, Outlook, iCloud, Exchange, etc.). No backend server for calendar data.

- **Fullscreen reminder** — covers all connected displays before a meeting; Join / Snooze / Dismiss; auto-detects Zoom, Meet, Teams links
- **Menu bar schedule** — NOW / NEXT / UPCOMING; browse six days ahead
- **Quick Panel** — **⌃⌥M** (default): summon schedule at cursor; vim-style **⌘ H/J/K/L** navigation; **⌘ M** mute / **⌘ U** unmute
- **One calendar** monitored on Free
- **Mute per meeting** — skip fullscreen alert for one occurrence without dismissing the event

Download (same app for Free and Pro): https://github.com/codeonholiday/codeonholiday/releases/download/v1.5.4/meetly-latest.zip

### Meetly — feature guides

- [Complete guide](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-meetly-complete-guide/): Install, onboarding, overlay shortcuts, settings, Free vs Pro, troubleshooting
- [Quick Panel](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-meetly-quick-panel/): **⌃⌥M**, keyboard navigation, join from anywhere
- [Calendars and mute](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-meetly-calendars-mute/): Which calendars to watch; mute/unmute meetings

### Meetly — Pro Lifetime ($9.99 one-time)

- Unlimited calendars
- [Apple Reminders](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-meetly-apple-reminders/) — due-date tasks fire like meetings; per-list rules
- Per-calendar reminder rules (overlay on/off, sound, repeat)
- iCloud sync of dismiss / join / snooze / mute across Macs
- Quiet hours; hide overlay from screen-share viewers (you still see it)
- Sound repeat limits per calendar

## LocalMelody — free

Private **local AI music generator** for **Apple Silicon** Macs (macOS 14+). Prompts and generated audio are not stored on a codeonholiday backend. Internet needed for first-time Homebrew / Ollama / model downloads and license activation; generation runs locally after setup.

- **15-second songs** on Free with automatic sound controls
- **Lyrics generation** on Free
- **Library** playback on device
- **Instrumental or vocals** workflows depending on downloaded models
- Requires **16 GB RAM minimum**; **32 GB+ recommended**

Download: https://github.com/codeonholiday/codeonholiday/releases/download/localmelody-v1.0.7/localmelody-latest.dmg

### LocalMelody — Pro Lifetime ($9.99 one-time)

- Song length **15–240 seconds**
- Genre, mood, voice, BPM, key controls
- Voice reference and lyrics refinement
- Export audio and lyrics

### LocalMelody — guides and comparisons

- [Complete guide](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-localmelody-complete-guide/): Apple Silicon requirements, Homebrew + Ollama setup, models, Free vs Pro, privacy, troubleshooting
- [Best local AI music generator for Mac](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/best-local-ai-music-generator-mac/)
- [vs Suno](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/localmelody-vs-suno/)
- [vs Udio](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/localmelody-vs-udio/)
- [Suno vs Udio vs LocalMelody](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/suno-vs-udio-vs-localmelody/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://codeonholiday.com/localmelody/privacy.html)

## HoverBoard — free tools (no Pro license)

Default hotkeys use **Control+Option** leader (remappable).

- [Screenshot](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-hoverboard-screenshot/) — **⌃⌥G**. Region or full display; Copy, Save, Edit
- [Screen Record](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-hoverboard-screen-record/) — **⌃⌥V**. Full Screen / Selection / Window; mic + system audio; trim, speed, crop; MP4 export. Not Notes meeting recording
- [Spotlight](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-hoverboard-spotlight/) — **⌃⌥S**
- [Break Timer](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-hoverboard-break-timer/) — **⌃⌥T**

Download: https://github.com/codeonholiday/codeonholiday/releases/download/v1.4.0/hoverboard-latest.zip

### HoverBoard — Pro tools (60s trial per open, or Pro license)

- [Draw](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-hoverboard-draw/) — **⌃⌥D**
- [Freeze & Explain](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-hoverboard-freeze/) — **⌃⌥F**
- [Whiteboard](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-hoverboard-whiteboard/) — **⌃⌥W**
- [Cursor Halo](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-hoverboard-cursor-halo/) — **⌃⌥H**
- [Keystroke Display](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-hoverboard-keystroke-display/) — **⌃⌥K**
- [Notes](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-hoverboard-notes/) — **⌃⌥N**
- [Sessions](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-hoverboard-sessions/)
- [Meeting recording](https://codeonholiday.com/blog/how-to-use-hoverboard-recording/) — from Notes; transcription + summaries (Pro)
